item.title: Wipro returns over ₹17,000 crore to shareholders through buyback, dividend, 2.6 times its H1 profit
item.description: Wipro returned ₹17,029 crore to shareholders in the first half of FY27, well above its net profit, after completing a major share buyback and paying a dividend.&nbsp;

item.title: Sebi reintroduces VWAP for derivatives expiry after CAS turns markets volatile
item.description: CAS, introduced in August, led to abrupt price swings on expiry day, making it difficult for traders to participate in the futures and options (F&amp;O) segment.

item.title: SEBI CAS: Framework revised; auction window set, reference price calculation for eligible securities changed - Details
item.description: SEBI has revised the Closing Auction Session framework. CAS will run for 10 minutes from 3:30 p.m. to 3:40 p.m. on trading days, with system-controlled order closure and auction-based closing prices. Cash-market reference prices will use the final 15-minute VWAP.&nbsp;

item.title: Nifty bucks global AI selloff as heavyweights flex muscle
item.description: The Nifty 50 index closed 1.66% higher at 22,997.35 on Thursday, clocking its biggest rise in percentage terms since 12 June. The Sensex 30 index closed 2.1% up at 74,315.61, similarly recording its highest rise since 12 June.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO to be listed soon: Why a 12% tariff hike may be coming in 3-4 months? Experts explain reasons
item.description: A Centrum report expects telecom tariffs to rise 12–15% over the next three to four months, citing limited competition and strong demand for 5G fixed wireless and broadband.

item.title: Wipro ADRs surge 5% to two-month high despite Q2 profit dip: Is anti-AI trade driving gains?
item.description: Wipro ADRs rose 5% to a nearly two-month high despite muted September-quarter results. Revenue increased modestly, while net profit and deal bookings declined. The company forecast Q3 IT services revenue of $2.571 billion to $2.625 billion, and its CEO expressed optimism about upcoming bookings.

item.title: Textile stocks’ dividend race: Premco Global, Monte Carlo, Siyaram, Ambika Cotton - Which stock spins highest yield?
item.description: Indian textile stocks are attracting attention amid supply-chain diversification, policy support and better trade access. Premco Global posted the highest one-year dividend yield at 9.5%, boosted by a special dividend.&nbsp;

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO: Uday Kotak draws interesting link between Reliance’s 1977 listing and Jio market debut
item.description: Recalling the moment, Kotak said that one evening in 1977, he saw the entire stretch of Marine Drive and Chowpatty illuminated and was told it was part of the IPO marketing campaign for Reliance Textile Industries, founded by Dhirubhai Ambani.

item.title: SK Hynix stock: Up big in H1, down 58% from peak in H2 — is the AI boom losing steam?
item.description: SK Hynix has plunged 58% from its summer peak as investors reassess the AI-driven memory boom. Concerns include Chinese rival CXMT’s progress, potentially higher borrowing costs and uncertainty over the sustainability of spending on data centres and related infrastructure.

item.title: Q2 results: Tech Mahindra dividend, bonus shares - Double delight for 7 lakh investors | Payout, ratio, record date
item.description: Tech Mahindra reported a 32.74% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹1,585.6 crore, while revenue grew 15.6% to ₹16,180.2 crore. The company announced an interim dividend of ₹15 per share and a 1:1 bonus issue. Check details

item.title: Bank of America shares flat after earnings-driven sell-off, slide over 20% from recent peak
item.description: Bank of America shares have fallen nearly 21% from their record high amid tighter monetary policy concerns and weak quarterly results. Earnings dropped 17% to $6.9 billion after a $1.2 billion regulatory fine, while revenue and trading results disappointed.&nbsp;

item.title: IRFC Q2 results 2026, dividend: Navratna PSU declares highest-ever dividend; Profit rises 10% to ₹1,958 cr
item.description: IRFC reported a 10% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹1,958.48 crore, while quarterly revenue reached ₹7,866.41 crore. Its board approved a record interim dividend of ₹1.15 per share, with October 23, 2026, set as the record date.

item.title: Rentomojo share price jumps 38% from IPO price in nearly 1 month | Check 5 factors driving the surge
item.description: Rentomojo shares have risen 38% above their IPO price after strong Q1 FY27 results showed 51% revenue growth, higher customer demand, improved inventory utilisation and better monetisation. Expansion plans and cash generation support its growth outlook.

item.title: Private capex losing steam in India: Can it delay the stock market revival? Experts decode
item.description: India’s private capex is losing momentum: spending per enterprise fell from ₹260 crore in FY23 to ₹160 crore in FY26, with planned FY27 outlays showing no rebound. Weak demand, rising costs and uncertainty are holding firms back.

item.title: Newly listed stock has 30% upside potential! JM Financial issues buy call; Check target price and key triggers
item.description: Shiprocket received a bullish outlook from JM Financial, which sees revenue rising to ₹43.4 billion by FY29. The brokerage expects its core shipping business to expand steadily and emerging businesses to become profitable in FY29. It set a ₹165 target price, indicating 30% upside.

item.title: ICICI Life Insurance shares: Despite 34% slump in 2026, Religare sees 42% upside post Q2 results | Here's why
item.description: Religare Broking reiterated its ‘Buy’ rating on ICICI Life Insurance, with a target price of ₹650, implying a 42.6% upside. The brokerage cited leadership continuity, distribution strategy and operating efficiency as key growth drivers, while flagging near-term softness in some product segments.

item.title: BlackRock, ADIA, Norges seek anchor slots in Jio’s $3.2 bn IPO
item.description: About 15 domestic asset managers, including HDFC Mutual Fund and SBI Mutual Fund, are also seeking a share of Jio's ₹8,000 crore anchor book.

item.title: Wipro Q2 results: Net profit falls 2% YoY to ₹3,200 crore; revenue rises 9%
item.description: Wipro reported September-quarter revenue of ₹24,752.7 crore, up 1.1% sequentially and 9.0% year-on-year. Consolidated net profit fell 4.7% quarter-on-quarter to ₹3,199.7 crore and declined 1.9% from a year earlier.

item.title: ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, SBI, Axis Bank: Which banking stock to buy ahead of Q2 results - What experts suggest
item.description: Brokerages expect banks to post healthy Q2FY27 earnings growth, supported by strong loan demand and deposit mobilisation. However, FCNR-B inflows and subdued low-cost deposit growth may squeeze private-bank margins.
